whisper.text: They sleep in stone. Only you can wake them.

welcome.text: Quiet... Do you hear it? That is the steppe wind. It remembers everyone who lived here.
My name is Üki. In the steppe, an owl feather was hung above a cradle to keep the child safe. I still keep watch — not over children, but over memory.
Behind these doors sleep those the steppe has lost, or almost lost. They turned to stone. Touch the glass, and they will remember. Follow me — and speak softly.

case.text: This one has turned to stone. Touch the glass to remember it.

end.text: The light ahead is waiting for those we remember.
